_comment: TEMPLATE agentic-loop config. Copy to <your-repo>/scripts/agentic-loop/AgenticLoop.config.json and edit. Keys marked TODO are project-specific; everything else is a sane default. Env overrides: AGENTIC_ENGINE, AGENTIC_PLANNER_MODEL, AGENTIC_EXECUTOR_MODEL.

promptOverlays._comment: Your project DELTA on top of ContainerHub's shared role prompts. Engine-agnostic on purpose: the loop composes shared+overlay once and delivers it to claude via --append-system-prompt-file AND to opencode as a GENERATED .opencode/agents/<role>.md. Gitignore .opencode/agents/ - it is a build artefact, and hand-maintaining it is how consumers ended up with drifted copies of the shared prompt. The legacy engines.<engine>.<role>PromptFile full-override still works but replaces the shared prompt entirely; prefer an overlay.

claude._comment: Claude Code CLI (claude -p). Planner: Opus 5 with Fable 5 fallback when unavailable/overloaded (via claude --fallback-model). Executor: Sonnet. Planner is sandboxed to read-only tools + BACKLOG.md edits; executor runs with bypassPermissions (trusted repo).
claude.plannerAllowedTools: Read Glob Grep Edit(BACKLOG.md) Bash(git:*) PowerShell(git:*)

backlog._comment: skipPlannerWhenTasksPending: go straight to the executor while BACKLOG.md still has unchecked tasks. deleteCompletedTasks: prune completed (- [x]) entries from BACKLOG.md after each task — history lives in git.
